ACCESS2::access2_proc
Description
This iRules command will return the TCL procedure registered for
currently executing per-request policy expression. This procedure will
then be invoked in the hidden iRule to evaluate the expression (which
is the procedure body).
Syntax
ACCESS2
::
access2_proc
Examples
when
ACCESS2_POLICY_EXPRESSION_EVAL
{
set
access2_proc
[
ACCESS2
::
access2_proc
]
set
ret
[catch
{
call
$access2_proc
}
my_result
]
return
-
code
$ret
$my_result
}
Related Information
Valid Events:
ACCESS2_POLICY_EXPRESSION_EVAL
